verdict.rationale: Qodo is a SaaS code-review platform, so a full data export is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack documents no export feature or open-format download of findings, history, rules or settings. Nearby items do not count: `.pr_agent.toml` config-as-code, a viewable history of findings, self-hosted deployment, and MCP/CLI retrieval of findings are adjacent features or developer building blocks, not a documented way to export all data and leave.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
